name: Borgbar
author: Jon
description: Watch Borg and borgmatic backups from the Omarchy bar: when the last one ran, whether it worked, when the next one is due, and how each repository is keeping up.

barWidget.description: Backup status: last run, result, next run, and per-repository freshness.

schema.label: Show age on the bar
schema.description: Off leaves just the icon, coloured by state.

schema.label: Warn after (hours)
schema.description: How old the last backup may get before the bar flags it.

schema.label: Refresh every (seconds)
schema.description: Only reads local systemd state. The repository itself is queried on demand.
